typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Counterparty as string,
		Version as string,
		Reference as string,
		TransactionStatus as string,
		DenominationCurrency as string,
		CounterPartyLongName as string,
		Transactiondate as string,
		GPTM_MapKey as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		Counterparty as string,
		Version as string,
		Reference as string,
		TransactionStatus as string,
		DenominationCurrency as string,
		CounterPartyLongName as string,
		Transactiondate as string,
		GPTM_MapKey as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Counterparty,
		Version,
		Reference,
		TransactionStatus,
		DenominationCurrency,
		CounterPartyLongName,
		Transactiondate,
		GPTM_MapKey),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
